label: Figure 10.9: Using the AC curve to show profit (Abnormal profit case)
alt: MC, AC, D = AR and MR with the profit-maximising output q where MC = MR; the shaded rectangle between price p and average cost a, of width q, is abnormal profit.
caption: The U-shaped AC curve is drawn so that MC cuts it at its minimum. At the profit-maximising output q (where MC = MR) the price is p (read from AR) and the average cost is a (read from AC). Because p > a, the shaded rectangle of height (p − a) and width q is the total abnormal profit.
